description_zh: Chess Drive 西行车道上,Zoox(AV,ego)直行时,其右侧停车道内一辆平行停靠的 2012 Nissan 轿车突然起步并入 ego 行驶车道、未打转向灯也未让行,侧向切入导致 ego 右前侧与 Nissan 左前侧接触碰撞,属典型'停车道车辆突然切入'场景。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) in autonomy was traveling westbound on Chess Drive in Foster City
a parallel-parked passenger car (Vehicle 2) abruptly entered the Zoox vehicle's travel lane from a parking space in the right parking lane without yielding or activating a turn signal
Vehicle 2 made contact with the right front side and wheel of the Zoox vehicle
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: ... L. ENTERING TRAFFIC VEH 2 X
WEATHER ... A. CLEAR VEH 1 X, VEH 2 X; LIGHTING: A. DAYLIGHT
evidence.reason: 双方均为移动车辆且存在交互:ego(AV)沿本车道直行,Nissan 从右侧停车道突然并入 ego 车道,符合 cut_in(侧向切入)原语 + position=adjacent/side=right;'abruptly' 按定性表取 trig_ttc=1.5。天气 clear、白天 4:02PM→afternoon、路面干燥不填 friction。碰撞记 v2 与 ego。
